task.title: unsupported suricata 8 sticky buffers
task.body:
gonids is missing support for quite a few sticky buffers as of suricata 8. I've hit parse failures on the following:

```
mqtt.connect.password
mqtt.connect.username
mqtt.publish.message
mqtt.publish.topic
file.name
smtp.rcpt_to
websocket.payload
```

for completeness, here's the complete list of unsupported sticky buffers:

```
dnp3.data
dns.additionals.rrname
dns.answer.name
dns.answers.rrname
dns.authorities.rrname
dns.queries.rrname
dns.query.name
dns.response.rrname
```

A couple of these (`smb.named_pipe`, `smb.share`, `krb5.cname` and `krb5.sname`) are supported in an underscored form.

Thanks for the help! For context, I'm trying to parse the Vulncheck initial access rule set to do some mechanical manipulations.
